answer: Each identity files a triple-entry bond, locking 70 credits and posting a marble record, a meadow stock entry, and a client-signed karst receipt. Auditors recompute the triple: marble quantity, meadow serial, and karst amount must agree, and each meadow serial spends once. A mismatch or reused serial burns the 70 bond. A forged triple costs 25 in fees, so the kth fake risks 95; 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 and pay 25,000, with no bulk discount. A rented-triple ring reusing one triple fails these checks and loses every bond. An honest agent files once, pays 25, and recovers 70 after a clean epoch.
